name: devrecap
description: Reconstruct evidence-backed developer work from authorized local coding history and let Codex turn it into polished recaps.

interface.shortDescription: Turn coding history into polished, evidence-backed work recaps.
interface.longDescription: DevRecap reconstructs what you actually worked on from explicitly authorized local Codex/Claude history and read-only Git evidence. The host AI then synthesizes those structured facts into polished daily standups, weekly reviews, sprint recaps, and memory reports while DevRecap keeps completion claims evidence-backed.
defaultPrompt: Help me remember what I worked on this week and generate a detailed recap.
Prepare my daily standup from yesterday's coding work.
Create a detailed review of the last 14 days in Portuguese, grouped by workstream.
